plotTwists: {user} reaches out to boop... and {target} isn't actually there. It was a decoy the whole time.
{target} catches {user}'s finger mid-boop and boops {user} right back, instantly.
The boop somehow triggers a chain reaction — everyone nearby starts booping each other.
A chicken wanders between them at the last second and gets booped instead, entirely unbothered. 🐔
{user} boops {target}, but it turns out {target}'s nose was extra ticklish — chaos of giggles ensues.
A tiny sparkle effect appears at the exact moment of contact, for dramatic effect. ✨
The Whisper Merchant appears and tries to sell {target} 'boop-proof nose guards.'

npcInteractions.line: That's disgustingly wholesome. I love it, don't tell anyone I said that.
Reminds me of my grandkids. Good, soft chaos.
Even my ancient bark found that unbearably cute.
The King has been notified and is, unexpectedly, charmed.
I don't sell boops, but I'd buy one if I could.
The winds carried the softest little sound for miles.
